notes.title: Patch 3
notes.notes:
Patch 3 for The Witcher 3 REDkit is now live, featuring a multitude of improvements to the most powerful modding toolkit on the Continent! Dive into the patch notes to learn more:

[h3]Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Scene Editor:
[list]
[*] Double-clicking on an empty animation event will now open AnimBrowser.
[*] AnimBrowser will now open on double-click.
[*] Double-clicking on the timeline will now create an event for the clicked track. If it’s an animation, it will open the AnimBrowser.
[*] The "Swipe" button will now remove Scene Editor's subtitles as well.
[*] If there’s a Scene Editor fragment, it will always show the scene subtitles.
[*] All additional debug information will be displayed when the Scenes debug checkbox is enabled.
[*] Enabling Free Camera Mode will restore the editor's default camera FOV.
[*] Camera FOV in preview will not be editable.
[*] FOV in Free Camera Mode will always use the last free camera FOV setup.
[*] FOV on the viewport will now refresh when switching cameras in Edit Mode.
[*] Viewport FOV will apply to the active camera on change (the edited camera in Edit Mode or to the free camera in Free Mode).
[*] Fixed issues with the Undo Manager.
[/list]
[*] Added an option to create .xml files in Asset Browser with correct encoding.
[*] The “World” tab will be updated with the current World name.
[*] Updated the Blender Plugin:
[list]
[*] Added pose bone weights for different NPCs, it can be selected during lipsync generation.
[*] Added interpolation easing while generating a lipsync.
[*] Fixed issues with installing the plugin on Blender 4.
[/list]
[*] Updated the credits in the “About” section.
[*] Added shortcuts to move plane and select plane for the world edit gizmo (press X and Y to select the XY plane).
[*] Added a button to set default lipsync and audio overwrite paths in scenes.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the tangent calculator didn't work properly for some vertices during uncooking.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Vertex paint tool wouldn’t save changes.
[*] Various UI fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dragging panels in the Scene Editor would cause a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where the editor would crash when loading a level while having a floating toolbar.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Item Select dialogue box would not close properly.
[*] The gizmo will now use thicker debug lines.
[*] Improved the check icon in the PropertyGrid.
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the .xml parser error would not show the correct file path.
[*] Various Scene Editor fixes:
[list]
[*] Saving will now always teleport to the first node.
[*] Fixed a crash on deleting any pause event on Timeline.
[*] Fixed a Scene Editor crash when switching from Edit Camera Mode to Free Camera Mode and trying to edit the camera from the Properties page.
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the minimap generation stretched output images.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading game definitions with standard templates would crash under certain conditions.
[*] Fixes for revert and drag-and-drop actions in Journal Editor.
[*] Fixed splash screen sizing for the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the world edit gizmo could get stuck when pressing two shortcut keys.
[*] Updated the Wwise license acquisition steps.
[*] Fixed an issue where searching for a quest graph block by name criteria didn't work properly.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: The Witcher 3 REDkit Modding Contest
notes.notes:
Unleash your creativity and take part in the official modding contest for The Witcher 3 REDkit!

This May we've released The Witcher 3 REDkit, an end-to-end solution which allows users to create new experiences and modify all aspects of The Witcher 3. It is based on refurbished versions of the same tools which were used by the RED developers to create this legendary game almost a decade ago. It's available for free for everyone who owns The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Claim yours here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684660/The_Witcher_3_REDkit/
Learn more on the official website of the editor:
https://www.thewitcher.com/redkit


Now it's time to show us what you can do with it for a chance to win amazing prizes sponsored by our partners. Including:
[list]
[*] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080, sponsored by [url=https://www.nvidia.com/]NVIDIA[/url];
[*] Gaming headsets, mice and keyboards, sponsored by [url=https://www.razer.com/]Razer[/url];
[*] The Witcher team jerseys and playing cards, sponsored by [url=https://www.dyenamik.com/]Dyenamik[/url];
[*] The Witcher varsity jackets, sponsored by [url=https://www.insertcoinclothing.com/]Insert Coin[/url].
[/list]

Ready to get started?

We invite you to craft a completely new questline made of 2-3 interconnected quests! Here’s your chance to tell your own tale and forge an adventure of your own making — whatever that might be! For each submission, we’ll be looking for creativity, originality, and technical excellence to shine through.

If the main task isn't up your alley or if you need a warmup, you can also take part in smaller Modding Challenges along the way! A themed challenge will be unveiled every couple of weeks to give you an opportunity to showcase your individual skills. There will be 3 in total, with the first one appearing soon!

In order to submit your mod, you will need to upload it on Nexus Mods at https://www.nexusmods.com/witcher3 and provide a link in the submission form available on the official contest website:
https://thewitcher.ly/REDkitContest
You will also find there a handy set of Frequently Asked Questions!

You can participate in as many tasks as you want. However, please keep in mind that:
[list]
[*] in the main category you can participate individually or in teams of up to 5 people (you can only be a member of one team);
[*] entries in the main category can be submitted until October 14, 2024 3:59 PM CEST;
[*] in challenges you need to participate individually, but you can take part in as many challenges as you wish (you can only submit one mod to every challenge);
[*] entries in challenges need to be submitted within specific deadlines, as communicated in respective challenge announcements;
[*] in order to be eligible in the contest, mods can't have been published prior to April 16th, 2024 1PM CEST;
[*] submitted mods can be updated until the submission phase deadline.
[/list]

Modding Challenges will be judged by CD PROJEKT RED and Yigsoft team members. For the Main Category, a shortlist of submissions will be made by CD PROJEKT RED and Yigsoft judges, while the final result will be decided by a community vote.

If you want to know more, the contest's complete set of rules and regulations can be found [url=https://thewitcher.ly/REDkitContestRules]here[/url].

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
The second patch for The Witcher 3 REDkit is now available. Here's the list of changes for this update:

[list]
[*] [Experimental] Added an option to start the editor in dark mode (View → Settings → Editor Configuration → Editor → startInDarkMode).
[*] REDkit is now shipped with pre-generated thumbnails. Users can update them for checked-out and added assets.
[*] You can now use a .jpg image as a thumbnail when publishing a mod.
[*] Added an option to disable the automatic reopening of resource editors that were open when the editor was last closed.
[*] Added an option in Scene Editor to generate all misssing lipsync and voiceover. It will use Windows' text to speech feature for voiceover, lipsync generation is possible if the audio is generated and the Editor knows the location of the Blender Plugin.
[*] Added the languages that were missing after cooking strings.
[*] Added scrollbars for the "Entry Attributes" section in the Color tab in the Entity Editor.
[*] Added support for additional virtual directories. REDkit can now attach additional directories besides the uncook depot (read-only). Essentially, your mod project can now depend on another mod. 
[*] Texture Viewer and Material Editor window layouts will now be saved.
[*] 3D gizmo handling will now interact correctly with the cursor.
[*] Added keyboard shortcuts for manipulating the gizmo. Shortcuts can be customized in "View" → "Customize editor shortcuts...".
[*] Set defaultPlayerTemplate defaultCameraTemplate when creating a new game resource definition.
[*] Hid some popups (e.g. New Game+ popup) that still appeared when playing from a .redgame definition.
[*] Using the "Tools" → "Generate missing unique script tags" option in Journal Editor will now properly fill out the missing unique script tag fields of new journal entries.
[*] Fixed issues with playback buttons in the Entity Editor.
[*] Editing multi-property values in Scene Editor by text will now be disabled instead of resulting in a crash.
[*] Implemented a material .xml metadata exporter/importer for Apex resources (CApexClothResource and CApexDestructionResource).
[*] Having the word "scripts" in the project name won't break script compilation anymore.
[*] Fixed the scaling of the "By Tag" editor window.
[*] Fixed description tooltips not always showing after hovering over a property field.
[*] Fixed an issue where recent projects could contain duplicates under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where when trying to save .w2mi files, the user was asked to "overwrite the existing file", although there was no file with the same name.
[*] Various fixes for the Journal Editor: removed non-functional elements, improved color coding, fixed checking-out and reverting.
[*] Added some fixes for importing scenes.
[*] Fixed some UI glitches in the Asset Browser.
[*] Several UI fixes for the PathLib Tool.
[*] Various stability improvements and crash fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
The first patch for The Witcher 3 REDkit is now available. Here's the list of changes for this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor could disappear in the editor after zooming in in the preview in the Texture Viewer.
[*] Generated navmesh instance will now be properly loaded back after saving and re-opening the world.
[*] Color picker in the Environment Editor will now properly show colors.
[*] Creating a new world and generating terrain will no longer fail when Ray Tracing is enabled.
[*] Fixed the trajectory calculation of bone motion extraction when importing animations.
[*] Various stability improvements and crash fixes.
[*] Various UI improvements to the Welcome dialog box.
[*] Editor will now check the game version before starting and warn the user if it's outdated.
[*] Various language fixes and tweaks.
[*] Disabled some not working or console-related debug filters.
[*] Editor will now remember the configurations in the Welcome dialog box even if the app was closed before starting completely.
[*] Map file (editormap.json) generated from the REDkit executable will now be included in the bin folder.
[*] New worlds can now be created as DLC mods.
[*] Assigned better default values in setup for Terrain Edit Tools.
[*] Added some new icons in the UI.
[*] Removed unused Import and Export settings sections in the Terrain Edit Tool.
[*] Removed the redundant Animation Friend tool.
[*] Made w3fac and w3dyng files editable if REDkit config is active.
[*] Various fixes for publishing on Steam Workshop.
[*] Added new tutorials (including WitcherScript documentation) to the [url=https://cdprojektred.atlassian.net/wiki/]REDkit User Guide[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: The Witcher 3 REDkit is now available!
notes.notes:
The editor for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is now available for free for all owners of the game on PC.

https://youtu.be/mMKZQLRkyfU


[h3]Are you a player?[/h3]
You’ll soon be able to enrich your time in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt with a wealth of options. From alternate clothes and hairstyles to brand-new characters, environments, and more!

Simply browse [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/witcher3/]Nexus Mods[/url]*, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/292030/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url] or whatever modding platform you like best and enjoy all of the new content created by the community. Don’t know how to start? Check out our [url=https://www.thewitcher.com/redkit]REDkit website[/url] or this quick and easy tutorial:
https://youtu.be/ULFFMLCP1v4

*If you use Nexus Mods’ Vortex for The Witcher 3, make sure to install the latest update!


[h3]Are you a modder?[/h3]
You’re about to get your hands on the same set of tools that RED developers used to create The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt almost a decade ago — refurbished and adjusted to the needs of modders! It’s an end-to-end solution that gives you bigger freedom than ever before in customising all elements of the game.

The Witcher 3 REDkit is completely free for all owners of the game on PC! If you own The Witcher 3 Wild Hunt on Steam, simply claim the editor here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684660/The_Witcher_3_REDkit/

Don’t know where to start? Not to worry! We’ve prepared a dedicated [url=https://www.thewitcher.com/redkit]REDkit website[/url] where you will find a set of answers to frequently asked questions, a [url=https://cdprojektred.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/W3REDkit/overview]comprehensive documentation[/url], as well as a series of video tutorials (coming soon)!

notes.title: Playtest ends on May 22nd
notes.notes:
The Witcher 3 REDkit premiere is right around the corner. On May 21st you’ll be able to download and install the release version of the editor. A day earlier we will disable signups for Playtest.

Don’t worry! You will be able to continue any projects you started on the Playtest version of the editor. In order to help you migrate your progress, the Playtest version of the editor will remain available until May 22nd for everybody who will have already signed up. Your editor settings should load up automatically, but if you’d like to make a backup, they are stored at: 
[list]
[*] <steamLibrary>\steamapps\common\The Witcher 3 REDkit\bin\r4LavaEditor2.ini
[*] <steamLibrary>\steamapps\common\The Witcher 3 REDkit\bin\r4LavaEditor2.sessions.ini
[/list]

Please keep in mind that while The Witcher 3 REDkit is available for free, it can only be claimed on platforms where you own the game. This means that if you participated in the Playtest, but do not own The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt on Steam, you will need to switch over to the store where you own the game. The editor will work exactly the same regardless of where it’s downloaded from.

Thank you for participating in the Playtest! Thanks to your feedback and reports we’ve been able to bring multiple improvements to The Witcher 3 REDkit!

notes.title: The Witcher 3 REDkit Playtest
notes.notes:
If you can't wait to get your hands on the editor for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, we have some great news for you! Starting today you can sign up to try it out yourself in the official Playtest on Steam.

The Witcher 3 REDkit is a comprehensive modding tool for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt we're currently developing. It is based on the same set of tools that were used by our developers to create the game and should allow for nearly limitless freedom in modding it. REDkit will be available free of charge for all owners of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt on PC and it's scheduled to release later this year.

In order to sign up, simply navigate to the store page of The Witcher 3 REDkit on Steam and request access:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2684660/The_Witcher_3_REDkit/
Playtest access will be distributed in batches. After receiving access "The Witcher 3 REDkit Playtest" will appear in your Steam Library. Remember that the editor will require The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt game files in order to work properly, so make sure you have it installed too!

We hope that you'll have a great time testing and everything will be going smoothly for you, but please keep in mind that you'll be running a beta version of the tool and might encounter some issues. Should you run into something serious trouble, you can report it to us using a dedicated form on our Tech Support website: http://thewitcher.ly/REDkit_report


Once you get the chance to try the tool out, we invite you to share your feedback with us — you’ll find a built-in button in REDkit taking you to a survey, but you can also share your thoughts on:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2684660/discussions/]Steam Discussions in the Community Hub of the tool[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.cdprojektred.com/index.php?forums/mods-the-witcher-3.69/]Our official Forums, in the MODS section[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/thewitcher]Our official Discord server, in rooms within the REDKIT section[/url]
[/list]
We can't wait to hear what you think about it!


But wait... That's not everything you can help us test!

[h1]The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Steam Workshop Beta[/h1]

Alongside the modding tools we're also working on enabling the Steam Workshop for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. You can help us check the update by participating in the dedicated Beta.

WARNING: Before participating, make sure to back up your saves!
Steam Workshop Beta testing and The Witcher 3 REDkit Playtest are related to each other, but completely separate. You don't need to participate in both and you can try out the Beta without signing up for Playtest, just as well as you can run Playtest while not participating in Beta.

In order to enable access to the Steam Workshop of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, you'll need to join a dedicated group on Steam:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/thewitcher3workshopbeta


Once you're a part of it, all you need to do is find The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt in your Steam Library, go to Properties > Betas and select "workshop_test" from the drop-down list. Once this is done, the game should update automatically.

Have fun!
